metadata.description: A curated public subset of Claude Code plugins: audio transcription, meeting notes, and a writing humanizer, plus the audio-transcription eval harness.

plugins.name: audio-transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe wav, mp3, and m4a recordings (meetings, calls, interviews, lectures, podcasts) into timestamped Markdown with Whisper: mlx-whisper on Apple Silicon, openai-whisper elsewhere.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Process meeting transcripts from a rec/ folder into professional markdown summaries with isolation between transcripts.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Detects em-dash overuse, rule-of-three, AI vocabulary, passive voice, negative parallelisms, and more. Upstream: blader/humanizer (MIT).
